# routeros_tool_traffic_generator_raw_packet_template (Resource)




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the raw packet template, referenced by `tx_template` of a stream.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `comment` (String)
- `compute_checksum_from_offset` (String) Byte offset at which the generator starts computing the two byte checksum that is placed into the packet, or `no-checksum` to leave the checksum untouched.
- `data` (String) How the packet payload following the raw header is filled.
- `data_byte` (String) Byte value in hexadecimal notation (`00`..`FF`) used to fill the payload when `data=specific-byte`.
- `header` (String) The complete packet header as a hexadecimal string.
- `ip_header_offset` (String) Byte offset of the IPv4 header inside the raw header, so that the generator can update the IPv4 checksum and length fields.
- `ipv6_header_offset` (String) Byte offset of the IPv6 header inside the raw header.
- `port` (String) Name of the `/tool/traffic-generator/port` entry the packets built from this template are sent out of.
- `random_byte_offsets_and_masks` (String) List of `offset:mask` pairs describing which packet bytes are randomized and which bits of them may change.
- `random_ranges` (String) Ranges the randomized byte values are taken from.
- `special_footer` (Boolean) Whether a special footer with a sequence number and a timestamp is appended to every packet. It is required for latency and out of order measurements.
- `tcp_header_offset` (String) Byte offset of the TCP header inside the raw header.
- `udp_compute_checksum` (Boolean) Whether the generator recalculates the UDP checksum of the generated packets.
- `udp_header_offset` (String) Byte offset of the UDP header inside the raw header.

### Read-Only

- `dynamic` (Boolean) Configuration item created by software, not by management interface. It is not exported, and cannot be directly modified.
- `header_length` (String) Length of the configured raw header, calculated by RouterOS.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
